subject: External Stacks Project formalization corpus (Axiom Math) and the in-project Mathlib stacks API

external_corpus.name: The Stacks Project, formalized

claims_as_published.source_text: The Stacks Project, ~7,500 pages, started 2005 by Johan de Jong
claims_as_published.coverage: thousands of theorems and definitions, thousands of Stacks tags
claims_as_published.method: hierarchical coordinated swarms of AI agents; multi-agent statement auditing; Mathlib reuse where available
claims_as_published.byproduct: dozens of Stacks statements found to need repair: missing hypotheses, positive-characteristic edge cases, claims false in the stated generality; explicit counterexamples constructed

ingestion_blockers: No repository URL is published in the announcement; the only access surface named is a web viewer (stacks.axiommath.ai).

No licence is named for the formalization code. The announcement says 'open source'; that is not a licence identifier. A targeted search returned no LICENSE file, no repo, and only MIT licences on UNRELATED Axiom Lean repos (AgreeToDisagree, PartitionPolynomial), which say nothing about this corpus.
The underlying prose is GFDL (Stacks Project), which is a different work from the Lean code and does not transfer.
Axiom states it does not submit AI-generated contributions upstream at de Jong's request, so the corpus is not reachable through leanprover-community channels either.

Toolchain unknown: no Lean or Mathlib version is stated. The in-project pin is Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib v4.35.0, and a corpus on a different toolchain cannot be consumed by this workspace regardless of licence.
external_corpus.evidence_class: external announcement, single publisher, self-reported scale; Admiralty C3 at best (credible source, claim not independently corroborated and not independently measurable from here)
external_corpus.what_this_record_does_NOT_do: It does not admit the 16M-line figure, the theorem counts, or the repair claims. Nothing was downloaded, compiled, or checked. Those numbers appear here as REPORTED, attributed, and unverified.

in_project_stacks_api.why_this_matters: The usable stacks integration for UOS today is not the external corpus. Mathlib already carries the stack-theoretic API, it is already on disk in this workspace, it is Apache-2.0, it is pinned, and its declarations already cite Stacks Project tags.

results: veilLTS : Cslib.LTS VeilState VeilAction, with a registered Deterministic instance

veil_mtr_preserves_updr_invariant: the Andon invariant holds along Cslib.LTS.MTr, i.e. over EVERY finite execution of EVERY length (unbounded; the 4.33.0 twin proves only a bounded 20x10x32 state lattice)

repair_andon: repair does NOT clear the stop line; only ResetAndonWithVerifiedSync can, and it checks sync first

formal/lean/ruliad/UosVeilCslib.lean.honest_cost: The 4.33.0 twin depends on NO axioms at all. Importing Mathlib/cslib brings the three standard classical axioms. sorryAx and Lean.ofReduceBool appear nowhere: `decide` is used, never `native_decide`.
formal/lean/ruliad/UosVeilCslib.lean.residual_risk: The 6-plane state and transition function are RESTATED, not imported: the peer file is on the 4.33.0 toolchain and is not a module. Two copies of veilStep can drift. Guarded only by the re-run bounded `decide`; no Mojo arm checks the mirror, because the peer-authored sync checker was not edited.

formal/lean/ruliad/UosStacksDescent.lean.build: lake build UosStacksDescent -> Build completed successfully (3,276 jobs)
results: glue_of_chain: a matching family on the 5 DECLARED overlaps glues to a global section -- why allSixPlanesEpochAligned may check 5 pairs and conclude about all 15

chain_link_not_redundant: delete ANY ONE of the 5 overlaps and a counterexample exists. The overlap graph is a spanning tree: minimal AND sufficient. This is the falsifiability control -- without it, '5 checks suffice' could only be made false by adding checks

singletons_do_not_glue: a cover with no declared overlaps does not glue. Six planes each reporting their own epoch is vacuously matching and says nothing -- the formal reason a per-plane conformance report is not a sync proof
formal/lean/ruliad/UosStacksDescent.lean.NOT_proved: No IsStack instance for any UOS pseudofunctor. The results above are finite combinatorics in the SHAPE of descent. The category-theoretic statement needs LocallyDiscrete C^op => Cat for the UOS chart category plus effectivity, and is ranked as a programme in 20261108-1642-uos-stacks-descent-criticality-ranking.json, not delivered here.
